lastCompletedStory.title: Route the post-merge makeRealIssueSpawnFn close/abandon/demote path through the shared helper, test the ship auto-close path, and audit all remaining consumers

nextStoryContext: src/release/post-merge.ts's makeRealIssueSpawnFn (private, ~line 351) now returns realOnMainSpawnFn (imported from src/git/on-main.ts) directly, instead of rebuilding the spawnSync options field-by-field; this is the production spawnFn behind the exported defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn, which back the ship auto-close step (performCloseStep in runPostMerge) and the `cam issue close/abandon` on-main verbs. The now-unused direct `spawnSync` import was removed from post-merge.ts (SpawnSyncReturns type import kept, still used by the file's own local SpawnFn type at ~line 47 for the git-pull/tag spawnFn). New test test/release/post-merge-close-maxbuffer.test.ts builds a real tmpdir git repo (25-file backlog, ~1.25 MB combined, sanity-asserted via git cat-file --batch to exceed 1.1 MiB, mirroring US-002's repo-factory pattern) and proves (a) closeIssueOnMain throws ENOBUFS with a locally-defined buggy field-by-field spawnFn fixture (the exact pre-fix shape removed from post-merge.ts) and (b) defaultCloseIssueFn (the actual exported production wiring, i.e. the ship auto-close path) succeeds cleanly against the same fixture. Full consumer audit (AC3) confirmed complete: all four field-rebuild sites are now fixed (index.ts file-local + triage from US-002, sidecar.ts suggestions-promote from US-002, post-merge.ts makeRealIssueSpawnFn from this story); the toBacklogSpawn passthrough adapters in issue-file.ts/issue-specify.ts/triage.ts/sidecar.ts forward opts unchanged (verified by inspection: `(cmd, args, o) => spawnFn(cmd, args, o)`); the default spawnSync in readBacklogFromMain/select.ts/plan.ts (plan.ts:196 `readBacklogFromMain(cwd)` with no override) is the real node:child_process.spawnSync, forwarded unchanged; src/commands/config.ts's field-by-field prodSpawnFn (~line 135-136) was confirmed out of scope -- it feeds applyMergeMode/branch-protection, never readBacklogFromMain. `grep -rc 'encoding: opts.encoding' src/release/post-merge.ts src/commands/sidecar.ts index.ts` sums to 0, matching the story's oracle. This closes out the CAM-311/CAM-307 maxBuffer-drop bug class across the whole codebase; no known remaining field-by-field readBacklogFromMain consumer exists.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Re-confirmed spawnSync's documented default maxBuffer (1024*1024) and that maxBuffer is just one field of the options object with no special forwarding required -- matches the fix (makeRealIssueSpawnFn now delegates to realOnMainSpawnFn's `{ ...opts, stdio: 'pipe' }` spread) and the new regression test's ENOBUFS/success assertions.
